integrity: Symbolic proof plus 2505 exact-rational checker assertions. The checker is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the all-finite-graph proof. Historical priority has residual uncertainty; independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite continuous-time directed SIS process with known positive immigration and recovery, calibrated uniform transmission multiplier, and bidirectionally positive edges. First derivative of the stationary distribution at zero transmission only. No finite-sample, higher-order, or nonlinear-response claims.
title: The cycle-space barrier to weak-contact epidemic network reconstruction
